About the Thunderbolts font

The Thunderbolts* logo is a custom, ultra-condensed sans that leans on the same heavy verticals as FG Studios' "Thunder" and the "Stem" typeface used across its poster. To get that same crushed, all-caps impact with a font you can freely use and export, we pair it with Anton — a solid, condensed display face.

Frequently
asked questions
What font is used in the Thunderbolts logo?

The original Thunderbolts logo uses custom lettering. This generator recreates the look with Anton — a free, open-license font you can style and download.

Is the Thunderbolts font free to use?

Yes. Anton is released under the SIL Open Font License, so the text you create here is free for both personal and commercial projects, with no attribution required.

How do I make Thunderbolts-style text?

Type your text in the generator above, keep the Thunderbolts preset or adjust the color, size and effects, then click Download PNG for a high-resolution, transparent image.
